companyName: Clearway Operating Solar Portfolio (12 U.S. projects, 50% interest)

sources.note: Clearway's June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q names Cardinal Portfolio JV, states the March 30, 2026 close, reports Clearway's 50% interest, identifies 12 western facilities at 225 MW, and distinguishes the JV from the full 610 MW Cardinal acquisition.

The October 3, 2025 purchase agreement identifies Clearway and the two Fengate blocker purchasers, Deriva/Symphony sellers, three top-level targets, a cash membership-interest purchase and 50% Clearway versus 50% Fengate collective pro-rata portions.

FERC's March 19, 2026 order identifies the Clearway/Fengate JV buyers, the relevant project applicants, the Brookfield-controlled seller chain, the proposed ownership transfers and formal authorization.
Fengate's March 31, 2026 release verifies its 50% interest, the 50/50 Clearway JV, 12 operating western U.S. solar projects, 227 MWac scale and Fengate Infrastructure Yield Fund/LiUNA attribution.
Deriva's October 6, 2025 release identifies Deriva and Manulife as sellers of the broader 833 MWdc/613 MWac operating portfolio to Clearway and identifies Deriva as a Brookfield portfolio company.

Independent exact-name filtering verifies 13 operating Deriva plant records across California, New Mexico and Colorado, totaling 227.8 MW nameplate and 225.2 MW net-summer. The confidential grouping of those plant records into the 12 publicly reported assets remains unavailable.

modelEvidenceCorrections: Use Cardinal Portfolio JV as the canonical public name rather than the census's descriptive Clearway portfolio label.

Keep the overall JV at 50/50; do not infer the undisclosed split between Fengate's two blocker vehicles.
